title: CMA® Certification (Certified Management Accountant)
summary: The CMA is the global benchmark for management accountants and financial managers, featuring Part 1 Financial Planning, Performance, and Analytics and Part 2 Strategic Financial Management with 12 core competencies, 50% MCQ gate, and Prometric case essays.

standard.name: Standard Professional Track
standard.blurb: Complete both 4-hour examination parts (100 MCQs + 2 Case Essays each), verify degree prerequisites, and document 2 continuous years of qualifying experience.

stages.title: Stage 1: Eligibility & Registration
stages.subtitle: Active IMA membership and educational prerequisites

nodes.name: Join IMA & Enroll in CMA Program
nodes.description: Maintain active professional membership in the Institute of Management Accountants (IMA) and pay the CMA entrance fee to open your 3-year testing candidacy window.
resources: Wiley CMA Exam Review (Complete Set Parts 1 & 2), Wiley / IMA
Gleim CMA Review System (Parts 1 & 2), Dr. Irvin N. Gleim, Gleim Publications
HOCK CMA Review Guide & Question Bank, HOCK international
IMA Statement of Ethical Professional Practice (CSO 2024-2026)
learningOutcomes: Apply financial statement analysis, budgeting, and variance analysis to strategic decision making
Design and evaluate cost management systems, activity-based costing, and absorption models
Implement enterprise risk management, corporate finance, and capital budgeting appraisal models
Adhere to high ethical standards under the IMA Statement of Ethical Professional Practice
